stories.title: Luis takes court for LSU amid eligibility drama, coming off bench
stories.summary: RJ Luis Jr. came off the bench during Wednesday night's game against UL Monroe, a move that promises to intensify the showdown between the university and SEC.

stories.title: Georgia AG encourages SEC to take 'action' vs. LSU, 'up to and including expulsion'
stories.summary: The Georgia Attorney General blasted LSU in a letter to SEC commissioner Greg Sankey, encouraging sanctions against the Tigers, "up to and including expulsion."

stories.title: No. 8 Houston takes down top-ranked Florida behind Thomas' 30-point showcase
stories.summary: Dedan Thomas scored a game-high 30 points and Houston pulled away in the second half in Wednesday's 86-76 win over No. 1 Florida.

stories.title: Playing hardball: Commish says MLB owners won't OK deal without cap as lockout looms
stories.summary: Commissioner Rob Manfred said owners will not accept any deal without a salary cap, leaving MLB on track for a lockout that could threaten the 2027 season.

stories.title: Ravens' Humphrey apologizes for 'criminals' quip about Baltimore; mayor responds
stories.summary: Ravens cornerback Marlon Humphrey apologized Wednesday for the derogatory comment he recently made about Baltimore on his podcast.
